description: A PHP class implementing REST API endpoints for TestLink, handling projects, test cases, plans, builds, and related entities, using the Slim framework.

classes.name: tlRestApi
classes.description: A PHP class providing REST API endpoints for managing test projects, test cases, plans, builds, and related entities in TestLink, utilizing the Slim framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the REST API, sets up routes, database connections, and configuration.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates API requests using API key or PHP_AUTH_USER header.

methods.name: whoAmI
methods.description: Returns information about the authenticated user.

methods.name: superman
methods.description: Returns a simple message indicating the superman route was called.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieves test projects accessible to the user, filtered by ID or name/prefix.

methods.name: getProjectTestPlans
methods.description: Retrieves test plans for a specified project.

methods.name: getProjectTestCases
methods.description: Retrieves latest versions of test cases for a project, including keywords and custom fields.

methods.name: createTestProject
methods.description: Creates a new test project after verifying user rights.

methods.name: createTestPlan
methods.description: Creates a new test plan from provided data.

methods.name: updateTestPlan
methods.description: Updates an existing test plan with new data.

methods.name: createTestSuite
methods.description: Creates a new test suite.

methods.name: createTestCase
methods.description: Creates a new test case, building its object and checking relatives.

methods.name: createKeyword
methods.description: Creates a new keyword associated with a test project.

methods.name: getPlanBuilds
methods.description: Retrieves builds associated with a test plan identified by API key.

methods.name: createBuild
methods.description: Creates a new build within a test plan, checking for name conflicts and permissions.

methods.name: updateBuild
methods.description: Updates an existing build, verifying permissions and name conflicts.

methods.name: addPlatformsToTestPlan
methods.description: Links platforms to a test plan after validation.

methods.name: byeHTTP500
methods.description: Outputs a 500 error response and terminates execution.

methods.name: msgFromException
methods.description: Formats exception message with line number.

methods.name: buildTestCaseObj
methods.description: Constructs a test case object from input, validating required fields and relations.

methods.name: checkRelatives
methods.description: Verifies that test project and suite IDs are valid and related.

methods.name: userHasRight
methods.description: Checks if the current user has a specific right within a context.

methods.name: checkExecutionEnvironment
methods.description: Validates environment for executing a test case, including test plan, build, platform, and test case linkage.
